title: Will Estee Lauder (EL) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Estee Lauder is positioned to potentially beat earnings estimates in its next quarterly report scheduled for November 2, 2026. The company has a strong track record of beating estimates with an average surprise of 29.88% over the past two quarters. With a positive Earnings ESP of +0.64% combined with a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), the stock has approximately a 70% probability of delivering another earnings beat.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company demonstrates a consistent history of beating earnings estimates with an average surprise of 29.88% over the past two quarters. Recent analyst estimate revisions are moving higher, reflected in a positive Earnings ESP of +0.64%. Combined with its Zacks Rank #3, this suggests a strong probability (~70%) of another earnings beat in the upcoming November 2, 2026 report.

title: Can Sally Beauty's Digital Growth Become a Larger Share of Sales?
author: Na
description: Sally Beauty Holdings (SBH) reported 11% global e-commerce growth in Q3 fiscal 2026, marking four consecutive quarters of double-digit online sales increases. The company's Sally segment saw e-commerce sales rise 20% to $52 million, while its Licensed Colorist On Demand service averaged over 5,200 weekly consultations with 28% new customer growth. Similar digital expansion strategies are being employed by competitors Ulta Beauty and Estée Lauder, reflecting broader retail trends toward omnichannel growth.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company demonstrated sustained double-digit e-commerce growth for four consecutive quarters, strong Sally segment performance (20% growth), successful customer acquisition initiatives (28% new customer growth in LCOD service), and improved app engagement with higher conversion rates.

Company is successfully driving digital growth through personalized shopping experiences, AI-powered tools, omnichannel capabilities, and social commerce initiatives. Stores fulfilled over half of e-commerce orders, and total net sales increased 8.9% with e-commerce growing in the high teens.

Company expanded online sales to 31% of reported sales (up 3 percentage points year-over-year), increased presence on major digital platforms (Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Tmall, Douyin), and leveraged AI capabilities for enhanced personalized marketing and consumer engagement.

title: Here's Why Estee Lauder (EL) is a Strong Momentum Stock
author: Na
description: Estee Lauder (EL) is highlighted as a stock to watch with a #3 (Hold) Zacks Rank and B VGM Score. The company has seen 12 analyst earnings estimate revisions higher in the last 60 days, with shares up 1.9% over four weeks and an average earnings surprise of +41.4%. The stock shows strong momentum characteristics despite its Hold rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company received 12 upward earnings estimate revisions in 60 days, consensus estimates increased by $0.13, shares gained 1.9% in four weeks, and it maintains a strong +41.4% average earnings surprise. Strong momentum and VGM Style Scores of B support positive outlook despite Hold rating.

title: Can Estee Lauder's Innovation Push Unlock the Next Growth Wave?
author: Na
description: The Estee Lauder Companies is leveraging product innovation as a key growth driver under its Beauty Reimagined strategy. Innovation accounted for 23% of fiscal 2026 sales, with the company expecting this contribution to increase by 200-250 basis points in fiscal 2027, led by skin care. New launches across skin care, makeup, and fragrance categories aim to attract consumers and strengthen brand demand, though success will depend on consumer reception and repeat purchases.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is demonstrating strong innovation momentum with innovation contributing 23% of fiscal 2026 sales and expected to grow 200-250 basis points in fiscal 2027. Stock has outperformed sector peers with 14.1% gains in three months. However, valuation premium (P/E 27.1 vs industry 23.28) and dependence on consumer reception of new products present some risk.

Carries Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with strong fiscal-year sales growth of 20.3% and earnings growth of 16.6% expected. Delivered impressive trailing four-quarter earnings surprise of 61.5% on average, indicating consistent outperformance.

title: How Helen of Troy Is Building a More Consumer-Led Brand Strategy
author: Na
description: Helen of Troy is restructuring its operations to prioritize consumer-led growth through faster decision-making and focused innovation. The company has implemented a new operating structure with segment general managers and is using test-and-learn models across its brands including Osprey, OXO, Braun, and Olive & June. Competitors Coty, Estee Lauder, and e.l.f. Beauty are similarly adopting consumer-centric strategies to strengthen brand relevance and improve innovation responsiveness.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is implementing strategic restructuring focused on consumer-led growth, faster decision cycles, and focused innovation with new operating structure and successful product launches across multiple brands.
Adopting Coty.Curated framework emphasizing focused investment, stronger consumer engagement, and disciplined innovation to strengthen brand relevance and improve consistency.
Implementing Beauty Reimagined strategy leveraging data, digital tools, and AI capabilities to enhance consumer understanding, accelerate innovation, and expand brand reach across channels.
Advancing community-driven consumer-led strategy that links consumer feedback directly to innovation and marketing decisions, maintaining accessibility and brand relevance.
